## 100 years of improving lives

In 1925, our founders, entrepreneur George Crowe and chemist, Henry Dawe, embarked on a venture with
little more than an idea, a vision and a belief in the power of innovation. Their idea was to make
lanolin, which is formed by refining the natural grease of sheep's wool.

It is this partnership between science and nature, of sustainability and innovation – that has
always been at the heart of Croda, throughout our centenary journey. One that has led us from being
a small family firm to becoming the global business we are today.

Therefore, our evolved brand not only honours our amazing legacy, but also reflects the kind of
business we have become, with an incredibly powerful Purpose, Smart science to improve lives™.

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]

* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to

purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our

# Home Page

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

ISO-26000:2010, ISO 27001:2022, ECOVADIS and WASH certified, ensuring the highest quality and safety
standards.

### Does Esteem Industries offer custom synthesis and toll manufacturing services?

Yes, Esteem Industries offers comprehensive [custom synthesis and toll manufacturing services][57]
for specialty chemicals. We have expertise in [ethoxylation][58], [propoxylation][59],
[esterification][60], and other chemical processes. Our facilities are equipped with
state-of-the-art QA laboratories operating 24/7.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

into a single forecast you can act on.

  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch

  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

# Leading Cenosphere & Microsphere Manufacturer in India

## Unleashing Next-Generation Technological Solutions

### PETRA INDIA GROUP

Welcome to Petra India Group – a trusted name in the manufacturing of Specialty Drilling Fluids and
Advanced Chemical Solutions for the Oil & Gas and Mining industries.

With a strong commitment to innovation, integrity, and quality, we operate six state-of-the-art
manufacturing units across India, backed by a production capacity exceeding 15,000 MT annually.

Our diverse product portfolio includes:
* **[FILLIT][21]** – Premium Cenospheres (Density 0.4–0.8 g/cm³, Size 5–500 microns), engineered for
  lightweight, high-performance applications across drilling and cementing operations.
* **[MICROLITE][22]** – a range of high-purity Hollow Glass Microspheres (over 30 specialized
  grades), Hollow Glass Microspheres for Lightweight & Thermal Insulation Applications, thermal
  insulation, and advanced composite formulations.
* **[OFC Products][23]** – our flagship line of Specialty Drilling Fluids, including water- and
  oil-based mud systems, completion fluids, and stimulation additives, tailored to meet the evolving
  needs of global drilling operations.

Serving a wide network of drilling contractors, oilfield service providers, and industrial clients
worldwide, Petra India Group combines technical expertise with a client-first approach to deliver
reliable, high-performance solutions.

Expanding our global footprint, we are proud to announce our new international office in Dubai,
located at Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba, reinforcing our commitment to closer collaboration and faster
service for our Middle East and global clients.

##### Vision

At Petra India Group, our core philosophy is rooted in creating lasting value—for our clients, our
employees, and society at large. Guided by an unwavering commitment to quality and integrity, we
strive to drive meaningful change across industries and communities.

Our mission is fueled by a powerful vision—one that goes beyond words and inspires purposeful
action. It serves as the foundation of our dedication to making a measurable impact in every region
we operate.

With a global outlook and a relentless pursuit of excellence, we are committed to delivering
innovation, performance, and continuous improvement. By setting new industry benchmarks, we aim to
empower progress and redefine what success looks like. Join us on this transformative journey and
experience the impact of purpose-driven performance.

##### Mission

At PETRA INDIA GROUP, our mission is to harness our specialized knowledge in chemicals to deliver
high-performance solutions that empower industries worldwide. We are committed to continuous
innovation, stringent quality control, and a strong focus on client success. Our goal is to provide
sustainable, reliable, and cost-efficient products that drive operational efficiency, ensure safety,
and uphold environmental stewardship across a wide range of applications.

Our client-focused philosophy reflects our deep commitment to understanding and addressing the
unique requirements of each partner. By fostering transparent communication, collaborative
engagement, and tailored product development, we ensure our solutions are precisely aligned with our
clients’ operational goals—enhancing productivity while supporting long-term sustainability.

escalating difficulty provide a compelling challenge for fans of skill-based games.

Baldi’s Basics Plus: Educational and Eerie

Baldi’s Basics Plus creatively blends educational challenges with light-hearted horror. Players
solve math problems and navigate through school-themed levels while avoiding the increasingly
strange behaviors of Baldi. The game’s unique approach to the horror and educational genre makes it
stand out as both entertaining and unnerving.

Night of the Consumers: Retail Horror

Night of the Consumers takes a darkly comedic look at the retail industry by placing players in a
grotesquely exaggerated supermarket where the customers literally are your worst nightmare. This
game is a thrilling survival horror experience with satirical undertones, focusing on the challenges
of customer service.

Yandere AI Girlfriend Simulator: Darkly Romantic

girlfriend whose love can turn dangerously possessive. It’s a psychological thriller that blends
romance, technology, and fear.

tracks. The game’s continuous updates and community-driven content keep it fresh and engaging.

the return of the ominous visitor. With more puzzles, storylines, and chilling scenarios, this game
builds on the foundations of its predecessor to offer even more thrills.

## Products

[BioLoop Surfactants]

#### BioLoops
####  

For many years we have been exploring the concept of engineering new surfactants using novel
bio-based technologies. Sustainable products from renewable sources have been around for many years,
but the majority have very limited functionality in terms of performance compared to synthetic
countertypes. Our remit was to develop a range of biobased products that offer comparable
performance against the synthetic products across many applications.

[More Details][26]
[Anionic-Surfactants]

#### Anionics
####  

Anionic surfactants are negatively charged materials that are available in a variety of chemical
types. The main classes being alkyl ether sulfates, alkyl sulfates, alkylbenzene sulfonates, alpha
olefin sulfonates, phosphate esters. They are used in a wide range of applications where they
provide useful characteristics including, emulsification, solubilisation, wetting, detergency,
dispersion and foaming.



[More Details][27]
[Nonionic Surfactants]

#### Nonionics


Nonionic surfactants carry no electrical charge and are available in a variety of chemical types.
The main classes are alcohol ethoxylates, alcohol ethoxylates/propoxylates, ethylene oxide-propylene
oxide copolymers, castor oil ethoxylates, amine ethoxylates, fatty acid esters and their
ethoxylates. They are used in a wide range of applications where they provide useful characteristics
including  emulsification, solubilisation, wetting, dispersion, detergency, foaming and defoaming.

[More Details][28]
[Amphoteric & Cationic Surfactants]

#### Amphoteric & Cationic 

Amphoteric surfactants can carry a positive or negative charge depending on pH, whereas cationic
surfactants carry a positive charge. There are a number of chemical types for amphoteric surfactants
including betaines, amidopropyl betaines, alkylamino dipropionates. They are used in a wide range of
applications where they provide useful characteristics such as foaming, solubilisation, antistatic.




[More Details][29]

][40]
Meet the BioLoop Family—Lankem’s innovative range of bio-based surfactants derived from soybean,
sunflower, and rapeseed oils. With over 98% renewable carbon content, BioLoop surfactants deliver
excellent detergency, wetting, foaming control, mildness, and formulation flexibility without
compromising performance. Discover how this sustainable technology is helping formulators reduce
reliance on fossil-based ingredients across industrial, consumer, coatings, and personal care
[Reformulating Around the LAB Squeeze ][Reformulating Around the LAB Squeeze ]
[

## Reformulating Around the LAB Squeeze

][41]
With LAB supply tight and DDBSA prices rising, Kemsurf SBE30 (LAS) is under pressure. Kemsurf OS38
(AOS) is built on a different alpha-olefin feedstock — sidestepping the bottleneck while matching or
beating SBE30 across most sectors: higher, more stable foam, superior hard-water tolerance, better
mildness, stronger cold-wash performance and ready biodegradability. From laundry and dishwash to
personal care and firefighting foams, OS38 isn't a fallback — it's an upgrade.
[Lankem's SOUNDS FOOD Project][Lankem's SOUNDS FOOD Project]
[

## Introducing the SOUNDS FOOD Project: Ultrasonic Cleaning Meets Bio-based Chemistry

][42]
Discover the SOUNDS FOOD project, where ultrasonic cleaning technology and Lankem's BioLoop
bio-based surfactants are helping reduce water, energy and chemical use in food and beverage
cleaning applications.
[Aqueous White Dispersions][Aqueous White Dispersions]
[

## Conventional Technology for Aqueous White Dispersions

][43]
This study explores how different dispersants influence the quality and stability of aqueous
titanium dioxide dispersions. Comparing a market‑standard polyacrylate with Lankem’s Lansperse SPA
and DS80, results show significant improvements in particle size, viscosity control, and storage
stability—especially with the high‑performing Lansperse DS80.
[Aqueous White Dispersions][Aqueous White Dispersions]
[

## BioLoop Technology for Aqueous White Dispersions

][44]
Following a laboratory study by Lankem into the performance of bio-based dispersants in aqueous
dispersions of titanium dioxide pigment, two products were shown to give excellent performance in
comparison to a conventional sodium polyacrylate dispersant.

ethoxylates. They are used in a wide range of applications where they provide useful characteristics
including  emulsification, solubilisation, wetting, dispersion, detergency, foaming and defoaming.

[More Details][28]
[Amphoteric & Cationic Surfactants]

#### Amphoteric & Cationic 

Amphoteric surfactants can carry a positive or negative charge depending on pH, whereas cationic
surfactants carry a positive charge. There are a number of chemical types for amphoteric surfactants
including betaines, amidopropyl betaines, alkylamino dipropionates. They are used in a wide range of
applications where they provide useful characteristics such as foaming, solubilisation, antistatic.

# Matangi Industries: A Snapshot

Incorporated in 1993, Matangi Industries is manufacturer of Specialty Chemicals and [Performance
Chemicals][222] with varied end usage. It started as a dyes intermediates manufacturer and later
pivoted into specialty and performance chemicals along with focus on [Custom Synthesis][223] to
serve specific requirements of clients. It currently employs more than 350 people and has a
distribution network that is spread across more than 40 countries around the globe.

# Specializing in elements that elevate product performance

[EXPLORE OUR PRODUCT FINDER][65]

### About Us

## Quality and ingenuity are always in the mix.

With innovative solutions that touch every aspect of people’s lives, every detail matters. That’s
why our processes combine cutting-edge formulation expertise and in-depth market understanding to
enhance your products in all the ways that matter most. From the vibrancy and feel of clothing and
carpeting to ingredients formulated with your body in mind, our purpose is to help your brand
deliver on its promise through industry-standard product enhancement.

[LEARN MORE][66]

### applications

## Solutions for every market.

At Polyventive, we believe that true innovation comes from anticipating customer demands and
understanding ever-changing market dynamics. From household, personal care, textiles, carpets, and
more, we utilize meticulous ingenuity and formulation expertise to develop solutions for the most
complex needs when it comes to your market dynamics.

### product technologies

## Products with a Purpose.

From our industry-leading surface treatments to our surfactants and safe acids, our specialty is
providing the perfect formula for yours. We blend chemistry and innovation to deliver a diverse
range of surfactants, dyes, polymers, and acids & bases to provide customer satisfaction while
meeting every application need with extraordinary durability and performance.

[VIEW ALL][68]

#### [SURFACTANTS][69]

From amphoteric surfactants to amine oxides to speciality blends, our product line promises the very
best performance and effects across every market.

[LEARN MORE][70]

#### [ACIDS][71]

Polyventive’s NOVOC series of acid solutions go unmatched, offering a series of safe acids to meet
every application.

[LEARN MORE][72]

#### [BUFFERS][73]

Regardless of the process or application, our complete class of buffers ensure control and efficacy
across the entire PH range.

[LEARN MORE][74]

#### [PEARLIZING AGENTS][75]

Our extensive offering of pearlizing agents and processing capabilities ensure the luxurious feel,
lather, and shimmer needed to elevate your products.

[LEARN MORE][76]

 

#### [Polymers][77]

Acrylic polymers and copolymers are our true specialty. We can meet all of your polymer production
needs for your unique market.

[LEARN MORE][78]

 

#### [AUXILIARIES][79]

Ensure the highest level of efficiency and most brilliant finishing effects with the right blend of
Polyventive’s auxiliary agents.

[LEARN MORE][80]

#### [DYES][81]

From direct and basic dyes to dispersed dyes, our colors and effects enhance the desirability,
performance, and longevity of all fabrics and textiles.

[LEARN MORE][82]

#### [PIGMENTS][83]

With Polyventive enhancing the optical properties and effects of your products, you get exceptional
vibrancy and coloration in every solution.

[LEARN MORE][84]

#### [OPTICAL Brighteners][85]

Our products and solutions cover all fabric types to ensure the brightest of whites in paper,
textiles, and more.

[LEARN MORE][86]

 

## Capabilities Customized to You.

Our team of talented problem solvers are capable of turning visions into realities for the most
complex and specialized product needs.

### HOW CAN I FIND BUSINESS PARTNERS AND BE IN THE KNOW ON INDUSTRY INTELLIGENCE?

SOCMA’s commercial network helps you find the right connections to develop partnerships with
contract manufacturers and customers. We are your bridge to finding suppliers and customers through
our lead sheet services, and we are your source of intelligence for end-market insights and product
applications. Our ChemSectors network provides the industry intelligence to make key business growth
decisions.

[grow your business][54]

### What resources will help me strengthen my operations, train my employees and improve safety?

Our compliance and stewardship programs promote and guide the implementation of safe, sustainable
and environmentally responsible operations across the supply chain.

[discover your resources][55]

### Where can I get intel on the latest regulations and policy specifically impacting specialties?

We are a powerful industry advocate. Our regulatory and legislative programs ensure you are always
at the forefront of any issues or policies that may impact the way you do specialty chemistry.

[find policy solutions][56]

### WHERE CAN I GAIN TARGETED ACCESS TO THE SPECIALTY CHEMICAL INDUSTRY FOR MY TALENT POOL?

SOCMA’s Career Center is the only one-stop shop for talent management and career resources for the
chemical industry. By using the Career Center, your available positions are advertised to a
segmented audience in the chemistry space, delivering better candidates and results.

[build your workforce][57]

## Discover Our Community

SOCMA provides invaluable access to key decision makers from hundreds of specialty chemistry
companies. Let us help you achieve your business objectives faster and more efficiently.

[Become a member][58]

### IN THE NEWS

July 20, 2026

#### [Raising the Bar: The Evolution of SOCMA’s Safety Recognition Program][59]

As part of our commitment to advancing safety performance across the industry, we are introducing
enhancements to the 2026 Safety Recognition Program that will place greater emphasis on performance,
proactive safety efforts, and continuous improvement.
[Read more][60]
June 8, 2026

#### [Solutions for Specialties: Showcasing the Value of SOCMA Membership][61]

The specialty chemical industry continues to face a complex operating environment marked by
regulatory uncertainty, evolving policy priorities, supply chain pressures, and workforce
challenges. In times like these, companies should be leaning into their trade association
to access timely information, industry expertise, and a strong network. 
[Read more][62]
May 13, 2026

#### [SOCMA Board Advocates for Domestic Manufacturing, Supply Chain Resilience on Capitol Hill][63]

The Society of Chemical Manufacturers & Affiliates (SOCMA) this week is bringing specialty chemical
industry leaders to Washington, D.C., for a series of meetings with lawmakers, federal agencies, and
policymakers focused on strengthening U.S. manufacturing competitiveness, improving regulatory
certainty, and reinforcing domestic supply chains.
[Read more][64]

to access timely information, industry expertise, and a strong network.

industry leaders to Washington, D.C., for a series of meetings with lawmakers, federal agencies, and
policymakers focused on strengthening U.S. manufacturing competitiveness, improving regulatory
certainty, and reinforcing domestic supply chains.

Stanford Chemicals Company, a hyaluronic acid supplier, offers high, medium, low molecular weight,
and oligomeric hyaluronic acid powder, suitable for skincare, joint injection, eye drops, drug
carriers, and food supplements.

The core benefits of Dihydromyricetin include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, liver-protective, and
metabolic-regulating effects. It also shows potential in improving chronic diseases and enhancing
immunity.

Chondroitin sulfate exhibits diverse pharmacological activities, including immunomodulation, wound
healing promotion, antiviral effects, and antioxidant properties.

## Applications

Silicone Oil Applications

###### Applied to car sponge

High active silicone oil, low density system, uniform cells, no perforation. It is suitable for high
powder adding system and can improve the physical properties (tensile force, elasticity) of sponge.
Suitable for vertical foam, flat foam, box foam, cover box foam.

###### Applied to refrigerator freezer

It is suitable for the opening of slow rebound. It is reactive. The hydroxyl value is 40, which has
no effect on foaming. Exudation problems.

###### Applied to plate

General-purpose silicone surfactant for the production of flexible polyether polyurethane foams.
Chemically, it is a non-hydrolyzable polysilane-polyoxane copolymer with high activity and
stability.

###### applied to paint

Mainly used as catalyst for polyurethane assembly line or bulk foam, suitable for producing
high-grade low-odor, low-atomizing soft polyurethane assembly line or bulk foam. Strong activity,
the recommended dosage is 0.08%. Especially after modification with polyether, it can be used as a
special functional catalyst of polyurethane foam stabilizer;

###### Applied to textile

Silicone oil usually refers to a linear polysiloxane product that remains liquid at room
temperature, generally a colorless (or light yellow), odorless, non-toxic, and non-volatile liquid.

[Surfactant]

As a global Contract Research Organization (CRO), headquartered in New York, USA, Alfa Chemistry has

## Our Products

Alfa chemistry offers a variety of surfactants for customers.
* [Anionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Anionic Surfactants
  
  Anionic surfactants are surface actives that ionize negative charges in water. In the production
  of surfactants, anionic surfactants occupy the maximum variety and quantity.
  
  [Product Info >][62]
* [Cationic Surfactants]
  
  ### Cationic Surfactants
  
  Cationic surfactant is a positively charged surfactant and refers to a hydrophilic base whose
  molecules are dissolved in water and attached to a lipophilic base.
  
  [Product Info >][63]
* [Non-ionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Non-ionic Surfactants
  
  Non-ionic surfactants, consisting of a hydrophilic head group and a hydrophobic tail, carry no
  charge and are relatively non-toxic.
  
  [Product Info >][64]
* [Amphoteric Surfactants]
  
  ### Amphoteric Surfactants
  
  Amphoterics are surfactants with ionic charge and they can change between anionic properties, the
  isoelectric neutral stage and the cationic properties depending on the pH value.
  
  [Product Info >][65]
* [Special Surfactants]
  
  ### Special Surfactants
  
  Polymer Surfactants, Silicone Surfactants, Fluoro Surfactants, Natural surfactants.
  
  [Product Info >][66]

  # High quality surfactant products can enrich our life and improve the living environment.
  
  Alfa Chemistry provides you with high quality surfactants and offers full support to meet your
  various demands.

## About Us

[Surfactant]

As a global Contract Research Organization (CRO), headquartered in New York, USA, Alfa Chemistry has
served the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries for years. Today, Alfa Chemistry is
specialized in organic chemistry, material chemistry, and medicinal chemistry.

[More info > ][61]
* [High Quality]
* High Quality
  
  After years of experience accumulation and technical innovation, we provide high quality
  surfactants to various organizations around the world.
* [Excellent customer service]
* Excellent Customer Service
  
  An excellent sales team & Professional technical staff.
* [Rich Experience]
* Rich Experience
  
  We have dealt with lots of products and our customers are around the world.

## Our Products

Alfa chemistry offers a variety of surfactants for customers.
* [Anionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Anionic Surfactants
  
  Anionic surfactants are surface actives that ionize negative charges in water. In the production
  of surfactants, anionic surfactants occupy the maximum variety and quantity.
  
  [Product Info >][62]
* [Cationic Surfactants]
  
  ### Cationic Surfactants
  
  Cationic surfactant is a positively charged surfactant and refers to a hydrophilic base whose
  molecules are dissolved in water and attached to a lipophilic base.
  
  [Product Info >][63]
* [Non-ionic Surfactants]
  
  ### Non-ionic Surfactants
  
  Non-ionic surfactants, consisting of a hydrophilic head group and a hydrophobic tail, carry no
  charge and are relatively non-toxic.
  
  [Product Info >][64]
* [Amphoteric Surfactants]
  
  ### Amphoteric Surfactants
  
  Amphoterics are surfactants with ionic charge and they can change between anionic properties, the
  isoelectric neutral stage and the cationic properties depending on the pH value.
  
  [Product Info >][65]
* [Special Surfactants]
  
  ### Special Surfactants
  
  Polymer Surfactants, Silicone Surfactants, Fluoro Surfactants, Natural surfactants.
  
  [Product Info >][66]

Committed to Asia Pacific growth

To enhance our developing strategy in the Asian-Pacific region, we re-named and re-directed our TER
Hong Kong office into TER Asia Pacific in 2019.  Our updated approach aims to structure regional
headquarters with the clear focus, authority and directive for specific regions of interest to our
company.

Originally founded in 1984, TER Asia Pacific Limited will remain on Hong Kong and the business focus
lies within countries such as (but not limited to) Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Japan, S.
Korea etc .

TER Shanghai Limited (founded in 2017), on the other hand, predominantly aims at business endeavors
within mainland China. While TER Shanghai is the first official subsidiary of this regional “hub”,
this will certainly not be the last as we aim to broaden our presence in strategically relevant
countries and regions throughout Asia Pacific over the coming years.

Our offices in Asia Pacific offer a wide variety of options as specialty chemicals and food
ingredients, such as additives, special solvents, intermediates, processing aids, special fillers,
pigments, food flavors, fragrances, ingredients and others. Key industries we serve include
adhesives, plastics, coatings, construction, personal care, home care, food, health care, nutrition,
pharmaceutical and industrial performance.

Both Asian entities are part of the TER Group, a leading German-based chemical trading and
distribution Company.

Committed to Asia Pacific growth

To enhance our developing strategy in the Asian-Pacific region, we re-named and re-directed our TER
Hong Kong office into TER Asia Pacific in 2019.  Our updated approach aims to structure regional
headquarters with the clear focus, authority and directive for specific regions of interest to our
company.

Originally founded in 1984, TER Asia Pacific Limited will remain on Hong Kong and the business focus
lies within countries such as (but not limited to) Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Japan, S.
Korea etc .

TER Shanghai Limited (founded in 2017), on the other hand, predominantly aims at business endeavors
within mainland China. While TER Shanghai is the first official subsidiary of this regional “hub”,
this will certainly not be the last as we aim to broaden our presence in strategically relevant
countries and regions throughout Asia Pacific over the coming years.

Our offices in Asia Pacific offer a wide variety of options as specialty chemicals and food
ingredients, such as additives, special solvents, intermediates, processing aids, special fillers,
pigments, food flavors, fragrances, ingredients and others. Key industries we serve include
adhesives, plastics, coatings, construction, personal care, home care, food, health care, nutrition,
pharmaceutical and industrial performance.

Both Asian entities are part of the TER Group, a leading German-based chemical trading and
distribution Company.

Shaping tomorrow.

Together.

TER INGREDIENTS S.L. es una empresa proveedora de materias primas de gran calidad y fiabilidad
situada en Barcelona. Con un énfasis especial en los mercados español y portugués, ofrece una amplia
gama de productos de origen internacional para satisfacer las necesidades de todo tipo de clientes
en las industrias de alimentación, alimentación animal, y farmacéutica, así como de otros sectores
específicos.

Gracias a la continua expansión de nuestro catálogo, ofrecemos una gran diversidad de productos de
primera mano, lo que ayuda a nuestros clientes a simplificar sus procesos de abastecimiento y a
optimizar su gestión de existencias. Nuestro equipo de especialistas posee un gran conocimiento
técnico y sirve de apoyo a nuestros clientes y proveedores, lo que convierte a TER INGREDIENTS S.L.
en un socio de máxima fiabilidad en España y Portugal.

Realizamos entregas combinadas de distintos ingredientes a tiempo y siempre cumpliendo los complejos
requisitos derivados de la normativa vigente y los parámetros de las especificaciones.

¡Garantice su éxito empresarial gracias a nuestras soluciones personalizadas y servicios de máxima
eficacia y calidad!

Shaping tomorrow.

Together.

TER INGREDIENTS S.L. es una empresa proveedora de materias primas de gran calidad y fiabilidad
situada en Barcelona. Con un énfasis especial en los mercados español y portugués, ofrece una amplia
gama de productos de origen internacional para satisfacer las necesidades de todo tipo de clientes
en las industrias de alimentación, alimentación animal, y farmacéutica, así como de otros sectores
específicos.

Gracias a la continua expansión de nuestro catálogo, ofrecemos una gran diversidad de productos de
primera mano, lo que ayuda a nuestros clientes a simplificar sus procesos de abastecimiento y a
optimizar su gestión de existencias. Nuestro equipo de especialistas posee un gran conocimiento
técnico y sirve de apoyo a nuestros clientes y proveedores, lo que convierte a TER INGREDIENTS S.L.
en un socio de máxima fiabilidad en España y Portugal.

Realizamos entregas combinadas de distintos ingredientes a tiempo y siempre cumpliendo los complejos
requisitos derivados de la normativa vigente y los parámetros de las especificaciones.

¡Garantice su éxito empresarial gracias a nuestras soluciones personalizadas y servicios de máxima
eficacia y calidad!
